stanza: All my life is on me now

fury.line: Yo, my mind is seein' through your design like Blind Fury

missouri.line: But those old folks in Missouri

Up in Arkansas, they're fair

missouri.line: Pulled off the highway in Missouri
stanza: Pulled off the highway in Missouri
And lo, our hearts were heavy laden
Made for the chapel with some spray-paint
For all the things we'd held in secret
Lord, lift up these lifeless bones

All the rainbow's heavy tones
